supporting_observations.claim: At 13:35:14 UTC, WS-ESTONE-01 recorded a PowerShell process using explicit credentials for svc-billing while targeting DC-PIN-01; this record does not show whether authentication succeeded or failed.

At 13:27:48 UTC, a record on DC-PIN-01 shows a SYSTEM PowerShell process using explicit credentials for svc-billing while targeting FILE-PIN-01; the source IP is 10.51.20.10, and the record does not show whether authentication succeeded or failed.
The supplied records show explicit-credential-use events involving svc-billing near the scheduled password-rotation time, but do not establish the repeated failed logons described by the alert.

known_telemetry_limitations: Only two Event ID 4648 records are provided; neither establishes an authentication result or documents failed domain logons (T062-00001, T062-00002).
The records do not include the command line, script contents, or surrounding process activity for either PowerShell process (T062-00001, T062-00002).
The source IP 10.51.20.10 in T062-00001 is not mapped to a host in the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: That svc-billing authentication attempts actually failed repeatedly around 13:40 UTC.
That either credential-use event was authorized or malicious.
That the WS-ESTONE-01 activity was part of the scheduled password rotation or an approved BillingSync update.
Which host or user was responsible for the 10.51.20.10 activity, or what commands the PowerShell processes executed.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain DC-PIN-01 authentication records for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including failed and successful logons and relevant Kerberos events, to verify the alert and identify source hosts.
Collect PowerShell and process-creation logs, command lines, and relevant script or file-access audit records for the processes in T062-00001 and T062-00002.
Map 10.51.20.10 to a host and user for the time of T062-00001.
Check the password-rotation change record and BillingSync job logs to determine whether these events correspond to the scheduled change and manual job update.
